motivation: Assertion recall is 0.25 on batch 6 (3/4 gold matches rejected: prodc6-005 electron->electron acceptors, prodc6-033 vaporised fuel->Bunsen burner, prodc6-149 beekeeper->reduced hive; 1 accepted: prodc6-129 libraries->children/adults). The validator asks a NARROWER question than the gold relation: 'Does this sentence assert that X provides support, help, funding or encouragement to Y?' (scripts/trackb_two_stage.py:28). Hypothesis: rejection is driven by that narrower semantic frame, not by extraction quality.

levels_kept_separate.L1_extractor: is the gold triple emitted? (already measured in all probes; fixed here)
levels_kept_separate.L2_assertion: ACCEPT vs REJECT on extractor-confirmed gold pairs
levels_kept_separate.L3_rule: which assertion condition fires (see conditions below)

hypothesis.H-ASSERT-SCOPE: The assertion stage rejects gold provides pairs whose relation is not support/help/funding/encouragement (physical transfer, emission, instrumentation, modal giving, raw resource supply), i.e. a semantic-scope mismatch between the validator prompt and the canonical relation.
hypothesis.H0: Assertion verdicts are independent of the semantic frame of the provision.

design.material: REUSE of frozen probe materials only; no new sentences. Every item is an extractor-confirmed gold pair from a previous probe (position, lexical, event-nominal, agency, recipient, density, interaction).
design.why: isolates the assertion stage with zero new language design and zero new surface factors; L1 is already known-good for every item
design.labels: assigned from the frozen material's documented semantic_subtype/target_type BEFORE any validator call
design.no_new_surfaces: no sentence is authored, rewritten or reordered for this probe

predicted_pattern_if_H1: SUPPORT_FRAMING accepted >> NON_SUPPORT_FRAMING accepted; MODAL rejected independent of frame
mechanism_readout: L3 condition attribution: verdict + which prompt clause is implicated (support/help vs funding vs encouragement vs other) + whether the item carries modality in the sentence

decision_rule.scope_support: support-framed accepted substantially more than non-support-framed with L1 fixed, reproducing across >=3 independent probe sources
decision_rule.inconclusive: difference depends on one probe source or on one lexical family
decision_rule.negative_result: no scope effect; assertion verdicts track something else and Batch 7 becomes the external check
decision_rule.within_source_required: direction must appear in the lexical within-source comparison; pooled-only effects count as artifact

forbidden: no assertion-prompt edit during the probe
status_note: material selection is a deterministic label transfer from frozen files; selection script and item list will be built next, then freeze on go

analysis_hierarchy.primary: within-source comparison in lexical (SUPPORT vs NON_SUPPORT, n=14) - the only source stratum containing both conditions; diagnostic controlled finding only, not a statistical generalization claim
analysis_hierarchy.secondary_orienting: pooled SUPPORT vs NON_SUPPORT (45 vs 11), reported for orientation only; condition is strongly confounded with source and a pooled difference must NOT override a null/mixed lexical pattern
analysis_hierarchy.descriptive_only: eventnominal (15 SUPPORT) and recipient (24 SUPPORT) contain one condition only and provide NO condition contrast; they describe validator behaviour but support no condition-effect inference
analysis_hierarchy.context_only: batch6 known gold matches (1 SUPPORT, 2 NON_SUPPORT, 1 MODAL) are motivating examples, not evidence
analysis_hierarchy.excluded_from_contrast: NEGATIVE_DENY (22) is the false-accept safety control; MODAL (n=1) is a separate single-case diagnostic
analysis_hierarchy.interpretation_rule: A pooled directional difference WITHOUT a concordant directional pattern in the lexical within-source comparison is NOT evidence for an Assertion-layer effect; such a pattern would instead indicate a source/material artifact. Concordant direction in both analyses is a diagnostic signal, not a causal claim, given the small lexical sample.

design_limitation: framing label is confounded with source by construction (eventnominal and recipient are SUPPORT-only); accepted knowingly, not balanced by deleting material, per methodological decision
no_change_after_freeze: labels, source assignment and condition definitions are frozen; no rebalancing, no re-labelling, no prompt/rule/threshold change

results.interpretation_per_frozen_rule: NOT an Assertion-layer effect. The pooled difference (25/45 vs 3/11) has no concordant directional pattern in the primary lexical within-source comparison (3/5 vs 3/9), so by the frozen interpretation rule this is a source/material artifact, not a framing effect.
results.secondary_finding: eventnominal (explicit-support predicates, all 15) 15/15 ACCEPT vs recipient (access_display framing, all 24) 6/24 - the split tracks the explicit support verb vs the show/provide-access pattern, not the SUPPORT label itself.
results.false_accept_control: NEGATIVE_DENY 0/22 ACCEPT - validator rejects all denial controls, no false accepts observed.
results.boundary_note: of the 3 NON_SUPPORT accepts, 2 were flagged boundary cases (lesson_provision, towel_service); the third is fuel_supply.
results.residual: 3/4 batch-6 gold matches still rejected (005 electron->electron acceptors, 033 fuel->burner, 149 modal beekeeper->hive); the assertion layer continues to reject correct extractions but the rejection does not track the coded support/non-support framing.
